text:
maria: Hey team — we kicked off a POC with Aegis Bank. Primary asks: streaming SDK + function/tool calling + strict structured JSON outputs. Blockers right now: security questionnaire, on‑prem/Dedicated option, and pricing for sustained concurrent streams. Can @sam and @tony join a quick sync tomorrow?

sam: I can do it. Quick preface: streaming is supported in the JS/py SDKs via an async iterator so you can render partial tokens. For tool/function calls we return a `function_call` object you can route to your toolchain. Minimal example: 
```
// JS streaming example
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-small', input: prompt });
for await (const chunk of stream) { ui.append(chunk.delta); }
```
And function call shapes come back as structured objects you can validate before executing.

sam: Pricing note — streaming tokens are charged like regular generation tokens. For rough sizing: 100 concurrent streams x 5k tokens/day each -> send me time window & concurrency and I'll build a daily / monthly estimate.

ton y: (typo) tony replying — Security checklist: they require encryption at rest + in transit, customer-managed KMS/HSM optional, detailed audit logs, and network isolation. For the POC we can offer Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Private (VPC/on‑prem). I need the completed security questionnaire, expected IP ranges, and a short network diagram. We have SOC2 and ISO artifacts to share.

maria: Elaine from the customer sent the questionnaire earlier tonight and asked for a short demo repo showing streaming + function-calls + JSON schema enforcement. I'll share the questionnaire PDF in the repo. Call tomorrow 10:00am PT — can you both be there?

elaine (customer): Confirmed — I've uploaded the questionnaire and a small sample dataset. Also can you confirm whether function-calling can be restricted to a whitelist of tools? Security wants that explicitly.

ton y: Yes, function/tool calling can be locked down by policy; during POC we can enable a whitelist and disable outbound network access from the runtime. Need signed NDA for on‑prem diagrams.

sam: For structured-output, recommend using JSON Schema validation on the response and a strict post‑processing step. Example minimal output we usually enforce for routing: 
```
{"action":"route","confidence":0.94,"entities":[{"type":"account","id":"1234"}]}
```
We can add automatic regression checks in Redwood Optimize if you want eval alerts on schema failures.

maria: Next steps I will: 1) email IP ranges + expected QPS, 2) drop the repo link with streaming+function demos and a simple billing calc, 3) attach SOC2/ISO certs and the signed NDA template.

sam: I'll prepare the demo repo and a ~1 page pricing calc; will include hosted vs Dedicated vs Private cost assumptions.

ton y: I'll start the questionnaire review tonight and flag any high‑risk items before the call. If they require HSM we need procurement lead time — will note that.

maria: Great. See you at 10am PT. :thumbsup:
